command.text: declare @message nvarchar(4000) select @message = '' &VisibleFieldGridDetailShowing; select @message as message return

declare @taxType int, @taxAccount varchar(32), @taxCode varchar(32), @taxRate numeric(28, 6) select @taxRate = 0, @taxAccount = '', @taxType = 0, @taxCode = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_ma_thue_0' if exists(select 1 from dmthue where ma_thue = @taxCode) select @taxRate = a.thue_suat, @taxAccount = rtrim(a.tk_thue_no), @taxType = isnull(b.tk_cn, 0) from dmthue a left join dmtk b on a.tk_thue_no = b.tk where a.ma_thue = @taxCode
select 'var t=this;t._taxCode =''' + rtrim(@taxCode) + ''';t._taxRate =''' + rtrim(@taxRate) + ''';t._taxAccount =''' + rtrim(@taxAccount) + ''';t._taxType =' + rtrim(@taxType) + ';t._voucherCode='@@id';load$GridVoucherDetail$(t);t.$a.AmountFormula=t.$a.&AmountFormula;;' as message return

declare @message nvarchar(4000) select @message = '' &VoucherGoodsTypeGridDetailLoad; select @message = @message + 'setDefaultValue$GridVoucherDetail(this.get_element().parentForm);' select @message as message return

query.text: select @@fieldExternal from @@prime$partition$current a left join dmtk b on a.tk_no = b.tk left join dmtk c on a.tk_thue = c.tk&ESG.queryLoading; where @@whereClause order by @@orderByClause

declare @s nvarchar(4000), @baseCurrency varchar(32), @udFields varchar(max) select @baseCurrency = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0' select * into #r from @@prime$partition$current where 1 = 0 select @udFields = 'ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, so_lsx' select @s = 'insert into #r (ngay_ct, so_ct, ma_ct, tk_no, dvt&VoucherGoodsTypeFindingFields;, so_luong, gia_nt, tien_nt2, dien_giai, gia, tien2, ma_thue, thue_suat, tk_thue, thue_nt, ma_kh2, thue, stt_rec_hd, stt_rec0hd, hd_so, hd_ln, stt_rec, stt_rec0, line_nbr, ' + @udFields + ')' select @s = @s + ' select getdate(), '''', '''', rtrim(a.tk_dt), ''''&VoucherGoodsTypeFindingFieldsInsert;, a.so_luong, ' select @s = @s + case when @vcCurrency = @vcCurrencyInvoice then 'a.gia_nt, a.tien_nt2, a.dien_giai, a.gia, a.tien2' else case when @vcCurrency = @baseCurrency then 'a.gia, a.tien2, a.dien_giai, a.gia, a.tien2' else '0, 0, a.dien_giai, 0, 0' end end select @s = @s + ', ma_thue, thue_suat, tk_thue, thue_nt, ma_kh2, thue, a.stt_rec, a.stt_rec0, a.so_ct, a.line_nbr, ''' + replace(@stt_rec, '''', '') + ''', a.stt_rec0, a.line_nbr, ' + @udFields select @s = @s + ' from d21$' + left(replace(@e, '''', ''), 6) + ' a left join dmtk b on a.tk_dt = b.tk left join dmtk c on a.tk_thue = c.tk where a.stt_rec = ''' + replace(@vcID, '''', '') + '''' exec sp_executesql @s
select @@fieldExternal from #r a left join dmtk b on a.tk_no = b.tk left join dmtk c on a.tk_thue = c.tk&ESG.queryLoading; order by line_nbr drop table #r
